notes: Prices change. Check the pricing page before you rely on any number here.
A cache write costs 1.25 times the input price for a 5-minute cache, and 2 times for a 1-hour cache.
A cache read costs 0.05 times the input price on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5, and 0.1 times on Haiku 5.5.
The Message Batches API takes 50 percent off both input and output prices.
Thinking tokens are billed as output tokens.
On Haiku 5.5, a request whose prompt is over 100,000 tokens pays the long_prompt prices for the whole request. Its prompt length counts every input token, cache reads and writes included.
